settings.heading: Stuck between two beds? Ask us
settings.text: Sizing questions, delivery questions, 'will my Labrador fit in this' questions: send them over. We read every message and reply by email.

settings.question: Where's my order?
settings.answer: Your shipping confirmation email has a tracking link. Most UK orders arrive in [min_days]–[max_days] working days; a few specialist beds take longer, and their product pages say so. If it's running late, send us your order number and we'll chase it.

settings.question: How do I return a bed?
settings.answer: Tell us within [returns_days] days of delivery using the form above, with your order number. We'll reply with everything you need to send it back.

settings.question: Can you help me choose a size?
settings.answer: Yes. Tell us your dog's breed, weight and how they sleep, and we'll suggest a size. Or try the Sleep Match for a quick answer.
